ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Graffiti Framework
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The engine for the graffiti program (design/Jawa/graffiti_spec.md), superseding Graffiti Mod (Continued) (Mlie.GraffitiMod) per the owner's 2026-08-31 ruling: "we absorb the vandal-spree mechanic into our own framework C# and RETIRE Mlie.GraffitiMod from the mod list."
`ModExtension_Graffiti`: a data annotation any graffiti ThingDef can carry - a FORM axis (Scrawl/Tag/ThrowUp/Stencil/Paste/Sigil/Glyph/Piece) beside the FUNCTION axis (category - None/Devotional/Mural/Jest/Taunt/Code), quality support, maker/subject/faction/ideo tracking (Filth_Mark), relation-keyed viewer-reaction ThoughtDefs, a meme-affinity gate (requiresAnyMeme, tier C), tier-A ideoligion-icon sigil rendering, and a god-satiation-hook string a RUT content pack reads to call into mandrake.rm.ninefold.
GRAFFITI_PUNK_IDEOLIGION_SCOPE_1 (2026-09-24) widened the engine from four example marks into a system: a punk-urban register (tags, throw-ups, crisp non-fading stencils, decaying wheat-pastes), ideoligion sigils grounded in the vanilla Ideology/Biotech/Anomaly/Odyssey meme roster (tier A - every ideo's own icon+colour, zero per-ideo art; tier C - a meme-affinity glyph, gated by GraffitiPool to ideos holding that meme), a data-driven weighted pool selector, a player Designator + WorkGiver, a raid-exit tagger (a departing hostile leaves its own mark), going-over (a rival mark is replaced, never thickened), and scrub protection for own-faction/Devotional marks. Full RM/RUT seam and open questions: infrastructure/state/items/GRAFFITI_PUNK_IDEOLIGION_SCOPE_1.md.
The absorbed spree mechanic: an unhappy or idle artistic pawn seeks "paint graffiti" as Meditative joy (RM_PaintGraffitiJob/RM_PaintGraffitiJoy) or, on the RM_GraffitiPaintingSpreeBreak mental break, is forced to paint repeatedly for a stretch - both spawn RM_Graffiti_Vandal, an untrained scrawl mark with negative Beauty, on a nearby wall. Fresh C# against the real vanilla toil API (JobDriver_RelaxAlone's goto-and-gain-Joy shape, JobDriver_Floordrawing's spawn-on-completion shape) - the donor mod ships no source to reuse directly.
RM_Graffiti_Vandal's six texture variants are Graffiti Mod (Continued)'s own art, copied byte-for-byte under its MIT license (LICENSE.md, workshop id 2986996933, (c) 2020 Mlie) - see this mod's own LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md for the full notice. RM_BaseGraffiti (thingClass plain vanilla Filth, not the donor's custom subclass - verified CornerFiller linking needs no special subclass support) is a fresh abstract def so mandrake.rm.sacredgraffiti's existing marks keep working once the donor mod is gone.
Ships the engine plus four generic vanilla-register example marks (RM_Graffiti_Vandal, RM_Graffiti_Scratches, RM_Graffiti_TallyMarks, RM_Graffiti_WarningGlyph - GRAFFITI_GENERIC_MARKS_1, owner R7 2026-09-08). The nine campaign mark-styles move to Salvation (RUT tier) separately, not this mod.
